lane: Prefill kernel speed proof: gemv vs row-tiled attention on a live serving server
comparisonNotes: Machine-readable baseline for the row-tiled attention kernel decision.
Combined throughput improved from 23.26 to 24.78 tok/s (+6.5%) with a 6.1% wall-time reduction and peak working set dropping from 1353.8 MB to 1222.8 MB.

Resolved prompt row width is unchanged between runs (56 weight sub-batches for 1751 tokens), so the gain is attributable to quadratic attention past its crossover floor (>= 1081) rather than fewer weight traversals.
